name: RoCitizens 🏠
desc:
RoCitizens is an open world life simulation & roleplaying (RP) game. Enter the city with just the clothes on your back and work your way up to fame & riches, creating your own story along the way!
+ Fulfill your moods
+ Work jobs as a police officer, firefighter, robber, line cook, and more!
+ Build & furnish a house
+ Customize your character with unique outfits
+ Collect & modify cars and vehicles
+ Socialize & roleplay with other citizens
+ Explore a massive and constantly growing world
